Pessimism.definition: Negative expectations about the future; hopelessness.

Sense_of_failure.definition: Feelings of having failed or being disappointed in oneself.

Loss_of_Pleasure.definition: Reduced enjoyment or interest in activities.

Guilty_feelings.definition: Excessive or inappropriate guilt or self-blame.

Sense_of_punishment.definition: Sense of being punished or deserving punishment.

Self-dislike.definition: Disappointment in or dislike of oneself.

Self-incrimination.definition: Harsh self-criticism; blaming oneself for problems.

Suicidal_ideas.definition: Thoughts about death or suicide (ranging from none to active desire).

Crying.definition: Increased tendency to cry or inability to cry.

Agitation.definition: Restlessness, irritability, or inability to relax.

Social_withdrawal.definition: Withdrawal from people or activities; reduced engagement.

Feelings_of_worthlessness.definition: Feelings of being worthless or having little value.

Loss_of_energy.definition: Fatigue; reduced energy to start or sustain tasks.

Change_of_sleep.definition: Sleeping more or less than usual.

Changes_in_appetite.definition: Eating more or less than usual.

Concentration_difficulty.definition: Trouble focusing, reading, or making decisions.

Tiredness_or_fatigue.definition: Feeling tired easily or all the time.
